entities.name: Luis Sánchez-Moreno Lira
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Luis Sánchez-Moreno Lira was a Peruvian Roman Catholic prelate who served as the Metropolitan Archbishop of Arequipa from 1996 to 2003. A member of Opus Dei, he previously held positions as Auxiliary Bishop of Chiclayo and Bishop-Prelate of Yauyos.
